summary: On September 15, 2023, the City Council voted to approve a comprehensive plan to overhaul the city's public transit system, outlined in a 500-page proposal with a $1.2 billion budget. The plan expands light rail, buys eco-friendly buses, modernizes infrastructure and technology, improves accessibility, and proposes fare subsidies. Backers expect reduced congestion, new jobs, economic gains and lower emissions, and public reaction has been largely positive with expectations of delivery.
one_line: The City Council approved a $1.2 billion plan on September 15, 2023 to expand and modernize the city's public transit system.
key_facts: The City Council voted in favor of the public transportation upgrade plan on September 15, 2023.
The plan is outlined in a 500-page proposal.
The transportation plan was spearheaded by Councilwoman Angela Martinez and Councilman David Cho.
The plan has a headline budget of $1.2 billion.
The majority of the budget is earmarked for expanding the light rail system, with emphasis on connecting underserved areas to the central business district.
Funding will buy a fleet of hybrid and electric buses to reduce the carbon footprint of public transportation.
Modernization includes upgrading old rail tracks for faster trains, renovating stations, and real-time update technology, plus mobile ticketing and smart card integration.
Accessibility measures include ADA compliance across facilities, tactile paving, audio signals, and wider gates for wheelchair and stroller access.
The plan proposes fare subsidies for low-income residents, students, and the elderly.
The upgrades are meant to ease traffic congestion caused by a growing population and reduce strain on parking.
The project is expected to create thousands of jobs in construction and in long-term operation and maintenance.
Electrification of the fleet and increased ridership are intended to help achieve the city's emission reduction targets.
Public feedback before the vote was largely positive, with a clear expectation that upgrades deliver on efficiency, comfort, and convenience.
